title: Unintended Escape Character Injection in Code Generation
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude is putting more and more random escape characters in and not catching it. This happens in POM files when it changes <name> to <n> -- like 3 times a day -- and it happens in java where it likes to say \! a lot.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.76
- Feedback ID: f030ea0c-bbaa-4a0d-8932-84e534a0abf9
author: heymumford
